payload.title: M8 — Deliver portable Babulus rendering with local-first AWS Batch fallback
payload.description:
## Outcome
M8 — Deliver portable Babulus rendering with local-first AWS Batch fallback

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Decision
VideoML includes voiceover and open Auritus-backed local synthesis. Babulus is an optional paid rendering service with portable inputs and outputs.

## Completion
Child behavior stories pass with linked evidence. Cloud account, budget, and pricing values remain decisions to resolve before provisioning or enabling paid execution.
